t: What Archaeological Site Evidence Database Is All About
title: What Archaeological Site Evidence Database Is All About
description: Site evidence is the dug truth: stratigraphy (the layers: law of superposition), context (the association: where found), features (the hearths, walls), and the recording (the total station, photogrammetry). The excavation: destructive — record everything. The ethic: preserve, publish, repatriate. Dig once; the record is forever. This database is the complete site evidence record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
